title: Willow Bend
shortDescription: Willows, and a painter cut on purpose.
longDescription:
The river bends under willows. A flat skiff should be tied here. The painter is cut, not worn through. Deckhand Nett sits on the root with empty paws and a story he is willing to finish.
West is the landing. East is the osier holt. South is the skiff-line.

fixtures.name: Deckhand Nett
fixtures.lookDescription: A young-adult mouse in a tarred jerkin, no token on the cord. Try talk nett.
fixtures.examineDescription: A young mouse in a tarred jerkin cut the way the camp cuts them, with an empty cord at his neck where a token used to hang. His paws are tar-stained to the second knuckle from carrying other people's cargo. He smells of biscuits he was never given any of, and he keeps both feet in the water as though he would rather be somewhere he could not be followed to.
fixtures.dialogue: Nett sits on a willow root with his boots in the water, turning the empty cord at his neck over and over. "I know what this jerkin looks like. I wore it two months and I carried tins in it." He holds the cord out so you can see there is nothing on the end of it. "I never cut a rope. They gave the knives to the ones who liked that part. I do know which crate in the cargo hollow was the College's, because I am the one who carried it out. Talk nett if you want it back."

fixtures.name: Cut Painter
fixtures.lookDescription: A mooring rope cut clean. Examine it.
fixtures.examineDescription: The painter is cut clean, tar still soft. Weather frays a rope. A knife ends it. The knot on the landing post was not the part that failed.
